title: BoMo Works Signing Event
seo_title: BoMo Works Signing Event at Bolivar High School
description: This annual BoMo Works signing event recognizes apprentices, employers, and community partners in career readiness. The ceremony includes a welcome from Dr. Methvin, recognition of apprentice and employer signings, and breakfast afterward; students may bring family members to stand and sign alongside them. It is for BoMo Works students, their parents and family members, and employer partners, and takes place November 19, 2026 (Time TBD) at Bolivar High School, 1401 Highway D, Bolivar, MO.
